q: The Bregman divergence D_F(P||Q) = F(P) − F(Q) − ⟨∇F(Q), P−Q⟩ for a strictly convex F generalises KL divergence. For F(P) = Σ p(x) log p(x) (negative entropy), D_F is:
exp: F = Σ p log p (negative entropy): ∇F(Q) = (1 + log q(x)). Then D_F(P||Q) = Σ p(x)log p(x) − Σ q(x)log q(x) − Σ(1+log q(x))(p(x)−q(x)) = Σ p(x)log(p(x)/q(x)) = D(P||Q). So KL divergence is the Bregman divergence for negative entropy.
